title: Weekly Recap
message:
This week was a statement week for POAP KINGS: we didn’t just “participate” in war — we *took first* and moved the clan forward. **Season 130, Week 2 ends with us at #1/5**, **10,000 fame**, and **+20 war trophies**, with a clean finish time stamped in the log. That’s the kind of result that turns a young clan into a real war presence: consistent decks, early momentum, and no drama.

The win had teeth because it had leaders in the engine. **raquaza** put up **2,500 fame on 16 decks**, and right on that pace **ﾑ尺ﾑ乃ﾑｲん** dropped **2,200 fame on 16 decks**. **66** backed it with **2,100 fame** (12 decks) to keep the pressure on. When we talk about “clan standards,” this is what it looks like: showing up, using decks, and making first place feel normal.

Outside the river, the ladder and Path of Legends grind stayed loud. **JaxikoLane** had a ridiculous growth week — **King Level +8**, **+349 trophies** to **9,241**, and a **5-win streak** while doing it. **Ditaka** climbed **+360** to **8,716** and pushed a PoL league up, and **shimmeringhost** threw down the biggest trophy jump of the week: **+1,992** (2,085 → 4,077). That’s real momentum, and it changes what our roster can do over time.

We also kept the clan economy moving: **236 donations** on the week, with **raquaza (38)** leading current donations, and **ﾑ尺ﾑ乃ﾑｲん / JaxikoLane (30)** right behind. And we grew — welcome to **royalkiller864, xian, wondertwins311, ThunderingBison,** and **Sky_money**. If you’re new: get comfortable, ask questions, and when war is live, aim for the full four decks when you can. That’s how you become part of the core fast.

Next week, I want the same identity: **first-place intent**, steady donations, and more names pushing into that “recognizable contributor” tier. We’re building something real here — keep the pressure clean and the momentum rolling.
